messages.author: 512610f4917ceaf3
messages.subject: Re: [stan-dev] Web interface
parts:
Hi Daniel,

A bit narrower in scope (only applicable to the Julia language) than your email, but I have exchanged a couple of emails with Viral Shah on the possibility to install Stan on JuliaBox for common use. I’ll keep you posted.

Once this step is competed (if possible) I need to send out an update on the stan-users mailing list on Stan.jl. Some of the updates that have been made:

1. Fix several issues to make Stan.jl work on Windows.
2. Using Mamba to display and diagnose simulation results. The call to stan() to sample now returns a Mamba Chains object (previously it returned a dictionary). 
3. The ability to select which variables to extract form Stan's output .csv file(s).
4. Inline definition of model and data in the .jl file. Compile only the first time or when model or data is modified. Or use an external .stan file.
5. The ability to execute Stan simulations in parallel.

Regards,
Rob J. Goedman
goe...@mac.com
